decisions.quote:
Overall, the
results of the two ANOVAs point to a partial replication of the original analysis. A full
replication for the purpose of the present study would have included no main effect of
group (which was replicated for both tasks) and no group x position interaction
(which was only replicated for one task).

decisions.reason: The author explicitly states an overall verdict of a partial replication because the null main effect of group replicated across both tasks whereas the null group-by-position interaction replicated in only one task (and only two of four equivalence tests were significant), which codes as 'mixed'. Parent primary-source confirmation: Full Discussion states a partial replication and defines both reproduced main-effect nulls and a nonreproduced group×position null; additional position effects also differ. Whole-author partial verdict supports mixed without guessing from p values.
